Hi Derek, Marcus —

Thanks for the note. We investigated the invoice and the applied meter-offset. Summary of findings (short):

- Root cause: a migration/job during 2026-10-28 23:40 UTC to 2026-10-29 02:10 UTC incorrectly tagged a batch of staging telemetry with the production tenant tag (clearstone-prod). The mis-tagged events were picked up by our post-process sampling and attributed to ClearStone production namespace, resulting in ~1.2M additional tokens being retroactively assigned for the 10/29 daily rollup.

- Scope/impact: ~1,190,432 tokens (inference + embedding mix) => $38,740 on the invoice line.

- Evidence: we attached a 500-row sample of the misattributed events (clearstone_meter_samples.csv) showing event ids, timestamps, original environment tag, and reassigned tenant id. There is also a short provisional credit proposal (provisional_credit_proposal.pdf) outlining the proposed $27,500 credit to reconcile net of previously applied discounts.

VAT/tax treatment:
- ClearStone is US-based and not VAT-registered in our records, so the credit will be issued net of VAT (no EU VAT lines). If you are VAT-registered in a different jurisdiction, let us know and we will adjust the credit note accordingly.

Collections:
- We can issue a provisional credit and instruct collections to put the account back to status "no collection" for 30 days while you reconcile. To do the release we need a short acknowledgement email from your AP (finance@clearstone.io) confirming they accept the provisional credit approach and that the account will not be disputed beyond this reconciliation window.

Timing:
- Target to issue provisional credit: 3-5 business days after acknowledgement.
- Final RCA and permanent credit (if agreed) within 7 business days.

Next steps for us (what we'll do):
1) Create BILL-4521 with full samples and attach to your HubSpot record.
2) Prepare provisional credit note and draft PDF for your accounting team to accept.
3) Hold collections during reconciliation once we receive AP acknowledgement.

Attached: clearstone_meter_samples.csv (sample rows), provisional_credit_proposal.pdf (draft credit note).

—Kimberly Park
